_lineage: Generalises calibration run 3's frozen protocol.json (docs/evidence/2026-10-18/claude-code-calibration-3/): its shape with the values blank. Copy it to the run's evidence folder as protocol.json, fill every {{placeholder}}, hash the sources, commit it (the freeze), and only then launch; run_id is recorded at the launch and amendments are appended after it. Delete this _lineage key in the copy.
status: {{frozen | run complete; results in observations.json, scores.json, results-table.md and clusters.md; see amendments}}
frozen_at: {{ISO-8601 UTC time of the freeze commit}}
revision: {{this repository's commit the run is bound to}}
host: {{host name and how it launches agents, e.g. how many at a time}}

profiles.model: {{model alias as the host requests it}}

cases.grading: grader agent against the manifest's ground truth under classification.md; then one clustering agent and three lenses (reproduce, reachability, refute) per cluster of other S1-S3 findings, majority
grader_fields: truth (found, causeNamed, severity per ground-truth finding)
cases.pass_rule_set_at: at the freeze, before the launch

source_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF/CR normalized to LF
metrics: pass per case and the grader fields plus PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL (review), with raw and adjudicated falseBlocking
tokens and wall time per agent from the harness run file
usage-window movement over the run (readings with nothing in flight before and after)

accounting.prices_source: {{the price file and revision the rates come from}}
accounting.statement: estimate-only: the rates applied to harness-reported tokens as an all-input..all-output range; cache pricing not modelled; not a bill; unknown tokens null

timing: host-observed wall time per agent from the harness run file, including scheduling
privacy: {{what the subject is and what is recorded by hash only; no credentials}}
limits: {{every limit the run knows before it starts: the number of ground-truth findings, one run per profile, who judges, the box it runs on}}

classification.lens_schema: tools/calibration/lens.prompt.md (it carries all three prongs; a lens votes real only on all three)

judging_profile.key: {{the profile the grader, the clustering agent and the lenses run on}}
judging_profile.qualification: {{its review qualification in the host policy: revision and evidence, or null in the bootstrap case}}
judging_profile.limitation: {{null when qualified; in the bootstrap case (no review-qualified profile yet) exactly: judging profile not independently qualified, host-declared by <reviewer>}}

relayed_operator_text.statement: the harness relays no operator text into workers
relayed_operator_text._fill: {{if the harness relays operator chat into workers: put the relayed text here verbatim, before the launch, and replace the statement with: the harness relays this operator text into every worker; the candidate preamble reconciles it}}

usage_window_readings.before: {{reading with nothing in flight, before the launch, or null with the reason}}
usage_window_readings.after: {{reading with nothing in flight, after the run, or null with the reason}}
